Pretlak Puella is Košice Mid/Senior. Brigada.sk surfaced Bratislava reception work but communicative English is mandatory. Upwork WordPress jobs were low-budget or hard-development, and Spanish/USA-restricted VA results were ineligible. Facebook yielded 0 concrete publicly verifiable hiring posts.
